svg.title: IDA R1 carrier engineering drawing
svg.desc: An 88 by 88 by 8 millimetre stepped frame for an assumed 76 millimetre OEM case, and a system signal diagram. Prototype fit dimensions are unverified.

g.text: Dimensions in mm · assumed OEM case size · fit prototype, not manufacturing release
12 contacts total including reference and bias
OEM acquisition module + original insulating case
Supplier battery · wireless link · no brain-stimulation circuit
Dongle → local host → raw recording + quality checks
Record actual configuration, counters and event timing
No current diagnostic or treatment output
Frame height 8 · support lip height 2 · rail 5 · two textile retention straps; verify fit and retention physically.
SOURCE: IDA engineering proposal, 8 September 2026. OEM case and electrode dimensions have not been measured.
